India Loses to England in Hockey World Cup Match

India lost to England with a score of 2-4 in a Hockey World Cup match. The match was part of the FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2026. This loss makes a subsequent match against Pakistan crucial for India's tournament progression. The rivalry between India and England in hockey has a long history, dating back 78 years.
